newsitem.title: USA: Liuski CEO resigns, sells stake in firm.
newsitem.headline: Liuski CEO resigns, sells stake in firm.

text.p: Liuski International Inc said Friday that its founder, chairman and chief executive Morries Liu has sold substantially all of his 41 percent stake in the company to Chih-Hung Liao, who has also assumed the posts formerly held by Liu.
Liu will remain on the board of directors but has resigned as an officer of Liuski International and its affiliates, the company said.
The company said his 1,783,620 shares were sold in a private transaction for an undisclosed sum.

In a prepared statement, the company said, "We believe that Mr. Liao will bring new direction and vitality to the Company, which we hope will translate into an improving financial performance as his corporate strategy unfolds."

Liao is chairman and majority shareholder of Gemlight Computer Ltd, a manufacturer of computer components with operations in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China, and chairman and majority shareholder of DTK Computer companies, which are engaged in the assembly of computers in Europe and the United States
